  "sql": "WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT t.id,t.coord_owner_id,t.tool_name,t.invoked_at,t.duration_ms,t.status,t.call_origin,t.call_origin_source,t.args_json,t.output_ref,t.serving_host,t.serving_build_sha FROM harness_shared.tool_invocations t WHERE t.workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND t.tool_name IN ('coord:dispatch','coord:wake','coord:send') AND t.invoked_at>='2026-10-30T00:35:00Z'::timestamptz AND t.invoked_at<'2026-11-06T00:35:00Z'::timestamptz AND t.coord_owner_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT owner_id FROM harness_shared.fleet_membership_events WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND fleet_slug='nonp2p-bug-drain-luna-max-0930' AND fleet_role='leader' AND at<'2026-11-06T00:35:00Z'::timestamptz)), qualified AS (SELECT t.*,r.fleet_slug AS recorded_fleet,r.fleet_role AS recorded_role,r.at AS latest_role_at,r.id AS membership_fact_id,COALESCE(r.fleet_slug='nonp2p-bug-drain-luna-max-0930' AND r.fleet_role='leader',false) AS in_role FROM candidates t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT e.id,e.fleet_slug,e.fleet_role,e.at FROM harness_shared.fleet_membership_events e WHERE e.workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND e.owner_id=t.coord_owner_id AND e.at<=t.invoked_at ORDER BY e.at DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT 1) r ON true) SELECT tool_name,count(*)::int AS raw_calls,count(*) FILTER(WHERE in_role)::int AS in_role_calls,count(*) FILTER(WHERE recorded_role IS NULL)::int AS unknown_role_calls,jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(qualified) ORDER BY invoked_at,id) AS calls FROM qualified GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY tool_name",

    "advisory": "⚠ population-narrowing query shape: this SQL uses LIMIT; zero rows from the bounded query do not establish that the underlying population is empty. (EI-22433765987075358). ⚠ single-agent activity read: harness_shared.tool_invocations records MCP calls ONLY, so this window is NOT \"everything this agent did\" — native Claude Code Bash/Read/Grep/Edit produce no row at all, and this box's bypass-permissions preamble actively steers agents to native Bash for reads. Measured over ingested transcript parts (24h): native 54,009 calls across 183 agents vs MCP 35,479 across 128, so ~60% of recorded tool use is invisible here. The error is DIRECTIONAL — missing rows can only make an agent look LESS active, so a sparse or empty window reads as \"idle\" and escalates into waking, accusing or reassigning a peer who was working (EI-21847759967934033: this ledger showed one agent making only coord:glance / activity:report while it was in fact running Bash the whole time). THE RULE: positive rows prove activity; absence here proves nothing.
